newsitem.title: UK: NWE naphtha quiet, but well supplied.
newsitem.headline: NWE naphtha quiet, but well supplied.

text.p: NWE naphtha markets remained in seasonal doldrums on Friday with most traders away from their offices and brokers said prices were notionally steady with crude.
They said business was very thin with no buyers around and sellers reluctant to offer into the void for fear of pushing prices down further.

Avails continued to look lengthy but assessments of sellers' levels were notional around $220 with no real offers seen. Relaxed buying interest from the petrochemical sector saw best bids around $216 a tonne cif NWE.
